scope: read-only simultaneous group placement screen; no CAD written
method: Native actual ink, full native mask inventory, silk, Fab/courtyard/edge. 0.8 mm height/width, 0.12 mm stroke. Candidate slots at 0.25 mm grid within 6 mm; 0/90 degrees. Existing target-group labels omitted for simultaneous proposal, all other objects retained. Conservative 0.15 mm spacing and 0.25 mm to outline. Screen does not establish label ownership.
